question: Which datasets support people COUNTING (ideally ESP32, ideally 4-5 people)?

on_disk.name: WiCount
on_disk.structure: 1 meeting room, 1 day, 15 recordings of about 60 s (count 0: 1, count 1: 7, count 2: 6, count 3: 1)

on_disk.name: OTH room2 samples
on_disk.structure: 1 room, 1 file of about 60 s per count

on_disk.name: Intel 5300 WiFi-CrowdCounting
on_disk.structure: 3 rooms, 1 recording per room and count
on_disk.use: non-ESP32 only; not mixed with ESP32 training

on_disk.name: EHUNAM subset
on_disk.structure: basement (MC1) and industrial lab (MC3), several days

online_checked.name: WiFiVision (WiFiVision-Counting-Tools)
online_checked.counts: 0-7, 1000 train + 200 test samples per class, 1 lab room
online_checked.access: ON REQUEST: Google Drive 'Request Access' with institution, intended use, project description, non-commercial confirmation
online_checked.verdict: best ESP32 source with 4 and 5 people; needs the researcher to request access

online_checked.name: Less is More (dilution) apartment mesh
online_checked.hardware: 9 x ESP32-C3 mesh, 72 links, about 10 Hz per link
online_checked.counts: none: hourly diary labels empty / sleep / active
online_checked.verdict: NOT a counting dataset; labels are hourly and recall-based. Not downloaded (only the 180 KB label files were checked)

online_checked.name: Same group's office deployment
online_checked.url: mentioned in the dilution README only

online_checked.name: IIT (BHU) multi-human activity
online_checked.counts: 1, 2, 3 users doing activities; no empty class stated
online_checked.access: IEEE DataPort subscription, 270 MB, licence not stated
online_checked.verdict: possible 1-3 source if a subscription is available

online_checked.name: Haron98 WIFI-CSI-Dataset
online_checked.counts: unclear: 4 unnamed labels per person (likely activity)

online_checked.name: OTH thesis full set
online_checked.verdict: best way to get more 0-3 ESP32 sessions

conclusion: No open ESP32 dataset with 4 or 5 people exists. Real 0-5 ESP32 counting needs either WiFiVision access (on request) or our own recordings with the V4 collection protocol.
